value.body: A bioprocess engineer runs the fermentation, cell-culture and purification steps that turn living cells into products such as vaccines, enzymes and biologic medicines. Biopharma, vaccine, enzyme and fermentation companies hire them. A day involves running and monitoring batches, filling in batch records, and working with quality teams on deviations.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: B.Tech Biotechnology or Chemical; M.Sc for some posts

items.label: Work pattern
items.value: Plant shifts and clean-room gowning are common

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers usually join a biopharma, vaccine or enzyme plant as a trainee or executive in upstream or downstream production, through campus placement or direct application. Some companies prefer an M.Tech or M.Sc for process development roles.

value.title: Skills you'll use
items: Basic process calculations and data logging

value.title: At a glance
items: Common next roles: process development scientist, technology transfer, production manager.
Work is audited against GMP rules, so documentation is constant.
Plants are concentrated in a few industrial clusters, so relocation is common.
